propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 with commonmark-to-jira conversion silently corrupts content: escapes punctuation inside code spans, deletes HTML comments, and rewrites `-->` terminators when naive arrow substitution is applied

A segmenting two-phase lexer must lock complete `{noformat}` spans, HTML comments, backtick/tilde fences, and four-space-indented blocks before classification to prevent pandoc corruption of protected regions

Inline Jira markup (unambiguous forms like `{{mono}}`, `[label|target]`, `{color:name}` and ambiguous forms like `*strong*`, `_emphasis_`) must be classified separately to avoid re-rendering oscillation when a rendered bullet starts with `* ` and re-renders as CommonMark
ASCII tables (>=2 pipe-bearing lines with delimiter row) must be wrapped exactly once in `{noformat}` and preserved byte-identical across multiple render passes

Every code fragment extracted before conversion must appear verbatim in the output after conversion, else the unit falls back to original Markdown to ensure code-preservation safety regardless of pandoc quirks

Corpus of 178 deterministic scrubbed bodies (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) must achieve >=90% body rendering coverage and >=95% character coverage with non-empty set of units that actually change when rendered
